transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I, uh... I guess things have just been kind of a lot lately. My sister and her baby moved back home recently, and... I don't know. Ever since then, I’ve just been more on edge than usual. Maybe a bit down. 

I keep snapping over little stuff at the house. And then I show up to class, or to the shop for work, and I'm just... already drained before I even start. I mean, I’m still getting by, mostly. But I've missed a couple deadlines... and I had to back out of helping with the theater set recently. I just couldn't keep everything straight. So, yeah. That's why I'm here, I guess.
Have you been feeling sad most of the time since your sister moved back home?
Uh... I don't know if I'd say sad. Not most of the time, anyway. Just... kind of worn out, I guess.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I don't really know if it's anxiety. Just... stressed, I guess. With the extra people in the house, it's just louder. Harder to think. But I wouldn't call it anxiety. Just... a lot going on.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?

I mean... I guess so. I still like doing stuff. It's just... I haven't really had the energy for it lately. Like I said, I had to back out of the theater set. But it's not like I don't want to do it. Just... tired.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them?
No, not really. Like I just said... I still like the same stuff. I'm just too tired to actually do any of it right now. It's not that I don't like them anymore.
Have you been feeling irritable most of the time since your sister moved back home?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... I've been more on edge. Snapping over little stuff at the house. And then... I don't know, I show up to class or the shop already drained. I'm still getting by, mostly. Just... missed a couple deadlines. And like I said, I backed out of the theater set. Just couldn't keep everything straight with all the extra noise and stuff.
Have you been worrying about things more than usual lately?
No... not really. I mean, I don't really sit around worrying about stuff. Just... trying to get through the day, I guess.
Do you feel hopeless about the future?
No, not hopeless. Just... tired, I guess. I don't really think about the future that much right now. Just trying to get through the week.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood for most of the day?
Not really. I mean... I wouldn't say I'm sad or anything. Just... like I said, mostly just drained.
Do you feel like you're in a low mood every day?
No... not every day. Like I said, it's not really a mood thing. I don't wake up feeling down or sad. Just... pretty worn out.
Have you been avoiding certain places or situations because of how you've been feeling?
No, not really. I mean, I still go to work and stuff. I just... don't really go out much right now. But I'm not avoiding anywhere on purpose.
Have you been experiencing any physical symptoms like a racing heart or trembling when you feel stressed?
Uh, no. Not that I've noticed. I don't shake or anything like that.
Do you often find yourself having trouble calming down after you get upset?
Not really. I don't... I don't usually get all that worked up in the first place, I guess. So, no.
Have you been feeling irritable almost every day since your sister moved back home?
Uh, no. Not really. I wouldn't say I'm irritable. We just kind of... stay out of each other's way, I guess. So, no.
Do you ever feel like you're on the verge of panic?
No. I don't really get like that. I'm fine.
Do you find yourself getting annoyed or irritated by things that wouldn't normally bother you?

Yeah... I guess so. I mean, I suppose that's kind of why I came in. Ever since she and the baby moved back, I've just been... more on edge, I guess. Kind of down. I have been snapping over little stuff around the house lately. 

And then I just end up going to class or the machine shop already feeling drained. I'm still getting by, for the most part, but... I don't know, I missed a couple deadlines. I even backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn't keep everything straight anymore. So... yeah. I guess little things are bothering me more.
Do you feel like you've been short-tempered most of the time lately?
Uh, no. I wouldn't say most of the time. Just... sometimes, I guess. Like I said.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?
Not really. I mean... I wouldn't say anxious. Just kind of tired, mostly.
Have you been feeling irritable for most of each day since your sister moved back home?
Uh... no. Like I just said, it's not most of the time. Just... every now and then, I guess. Not the whole day.
Do you frequently worry about the future?
Um... no, not really. I don't think about it that much. Just... taking it day by day, I guess.
